params.caption: 🏆 FURIA stun Vitality with a 13-0 map to reach the Rivals semis FURIA knocked Vitality out and booked a semi-final spot at Rivals, closing the series on a Mirage decider. Vitality didn't win a single round on that map, which HLTV says is the first 13-0 loss in the team's history. A huge statement from the Brazilians ahead of the final stretch. 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 10:02 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: HLTV 😱 React if you saw this coming · 💬 Can FURIA win the whole thing? #CS2 #FURIA #GamingNews
